name: Configurable secret backends and encrypted vault backups
captureSteps: Open the built app in a fresh browser context.
Pass the front door and seal a real vault with a PIN.
Open Settings > Features and enable Connections.
Open Settings > Integrations and scroll to Password managers.
Open the Proton Pass connection configuration.
After only: open BYO Secret Backend and select Local vault, 1Password Connect API, then Infisical API.
measurements: Actual input, select and textarea labels, types and read-only state.
Page, console, asset and HTTP failures.
functionalCases: Every canonical preset exposes its declared editable connection methods.
BYO composes all eight protocol configurations.
Connect, Infisical Universal Auth, Passwordstate and Bitwarden Vault Management: save, cold reload, authenticate, create, list, read, read notes, update and delete over real CORS sockets.
Official Bitwarden Secrets Manager WASM worker: authenticated encrypted CRUD, independent Node crypto validation, actual preflights; repeat under the active PWA service worker.
Real local-vault login and note CRUD.
Real Bitwarden JSON, 1Password CSV, Proton JSON, Proton ZIP and environment-file preview/import with the browser offline, followed by cold vault readback.
Canonical encrypted vault backup through Connect and restore into an independently sealed vault whose different enrolled PIN survives cold reload.
Official Save in 1Password custom element, activation event and explicit payload clearing; no extension account-save claim.
Actual Chromium PasswordCredential and credentials.store; no enumeration, deletion or vendor-selection claim.

Installed PWA: explicitly approve Secure note online, await the exact approved connection plan's OFFLINE_READY, stop the actual app socket, cold reload, first-use import Proton ZIP, cold reload again and read the persisted local note.
Backend credentials and imported password remain absent from plaintext local storage.
limits: HTTP providers are protocol fixtures with synthetic credentials, not hosted partner accounts.
Bitwarden Secrets Manager uses the real official browser SDK and independent encrypted server responses.
A real unlocked 1Password extension account is unavailable; its official handoff activation is tested without emulating extension success.
Proton hosted PAT CORS was measured anonymously; local export import is the supported browser path.
